description: This PHP file 'mainPage.php' serves as the main entry point for the TestLink web application interface. It initializes the page, manages user roles and permissions, retrieves project and test plan data, integrates with Smarty templates, and dynamically generates the main user interface based on access rights. The file also includes utility functions for fetching user documentation and grants/permissions related to the current user and project.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic empty class used to create objects dynamically within the script.

methods.name: getUserDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves list of user documentation files from the specified docs directory.

methods.name: getGrants
methods.description: Determines the user's rights and permissions regarding project and test plan management, returning an array of grant statuses.
